events.title: Thank you, Pro-Gamer
events.summary: Thank you, Pro-Gamer Yesterday, a few hours before Steam Next Fest opened, Charles "Grimtag" Ronchain of Pro-Gamer published an article about the KleptoMagia demo. It was one of the best surprises of the week. He writes that over the last three years he has seen dozens of Slay the Spire-style games, and that most of them add a secondary gauge without ever changing the rhythm of the fight itself. events.title: Casual Ties Studio announces KleptoMagia
events.summary: Hello Steam! We're Casual Ties Studio, a small indie team built on AAA experience, and we're excited to finally show you KleptoMagia. What is KleptoMagia?A real-time deckbuilder with no turns. Enemies cast live, the clock never stops, and every card you play is a split-second decision. Cast wisely and react fast. Your deck is the plan, but timing decides whether it works. Don't have the spell you need? Steal it from someone who does. How it playsReal-time combat: read enemy casts, time your card
